articles.title: Gen Trias City cites top business taxpayers
articles.description: GENERAL TRIAS CITY, Cavite — American semiconductor company Analog Devices and 19 other business establishments in the locality have been recognized by the city government of General Trias in Cavite province for being the city’s top business taxpayers for 2024 and 2025 during the Locators Night held at the General Trias Unity and Civic Center Hall in Barangay Navarro on Wednesday.
